title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
abstract: arXiv:2611.08472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%,

translated_title: XStack：一个用于机器学习代码仓库迁移的基准测试
translated_abstract: 机器学习代码应该运行在研究者选择的地方，而不是它最初被编写的地方。如今，机器学习代码主要存在于两个生态系统中：运行在 NVIDIA GPU 上的 PyTorch 和运行在 Google TPU 上的 JAX。在两者之间迁移代码仓库意味着需要跨框架和硬件进行构建与测试。这种迁移（1）是一种实际需求，因为它能为研究者解锁不同的硬件资源；（2）也是一个天然的基准测试：它涉及不同的框架和硬件、覆盖整个代码仓库，并且是长时程且具有挑战性的任务。我们提出了 XStack，一个评估智能体在这两个生态系统之间迁移机器学习代码仓库能力的基准。每个智能体会收到一个 PyTorch 代码仓库和一台干净的 TPU 机器，并且必须交付一个 JAX 代码仓库。只有当其输出满足我们的评分标准（该标准基于源代码仓库已发布的结果，并经过我们的认证和校准）时，才算通过。目前智能体的迁移能力仍然不可靠：Claude Opus 5 的通过率为 75%，GPT-5.6-sol 为 45%。
tldr: 该论文提出 XStack 基准，通过要求智能体将 PyTorch 代码仓库完整迁移为可在 TPU 上运行的 JAX 代码仓库，来评估其跨框架、跨硬件的长时程迁移能力，目前最强模型通过率仅约 75%。
en_tdlr: XStack is a benchmark that evaluates AI agents on migrating entire ML repositories from PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs to JAX on Google TPUs, a long-horizon cross-framework task where the best model achieves only a 75% pass rate.
